about: Modwerk source-only Machine Pages 1.2.1 (irpina’s 1.2 ported to Core 2.1) for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/dependencies/machine-pages.

mods.title: machine pages
mods.summary: Draws the SRC and LFO pages of the SRC machines that describe their own, gives the render an event for machines that make or take a track's sound, and from 1.2 lets a machine have up to seven more SRC values on a second page, so several machine mods combine. irpina's Machine Pages 1.2, ported to run on Core 2.1. On its own, and for machines that do not describe a page, it changes nothing the unit does.

On its own, and for machines that do not describe a page, it changes nothing the unit does.
mods.author: irpina
mods.on_unit: Shared dependency of the Digitakt machine mods; included automatically. Not run on a unit in Modwerk.
